verdict.rationale: Visa says its MCP server and Agent Toolkit let developers and non-technical users work with AI agents in plain language with no coding. The MCP server connects to Intelligent Commerce APIs, and the npm package resolves live. However, the toolkit's documented tools cover only Pay by Link and Invoicing, and natural-language operation depends on a third-party agent or LLM client rather than a first-party conversational interface. Missing for 10: evidence that core Intelligent Commerce flows (enrollment, purchase intents, credential retrieval) can be driven by natural-language commands, hands-on or independent corroboration of plain-language operation, and a first-party natural-language interface.
